messages.heading: Email Signature Generator
messages.name: What is your first and last name?
messages.office: Would you like to include your office phone number?
messages.officePhone: What is your office phone number? (i.e., 555.786.7700)
messages.mobile: Would you like to include your mobile phone number?
messages.mobilePhone: What is your mobile phone number? (i.e., 555.554.1417)
messages.howTo: How to add your signature to your Gmail account:
messages.how1: Select which style you'd like to copy by clicking the button.
messages.how3: Select the gear icon, then select "View all settings" from the drop-down menu.
messages.how5: Select "+ Add Signature" and enter a name for your new signature.
messages.how6: Paste your signature into the box (control-v for Windows, command-v for MacOS, or right click and use "Paste" from the menu).
messages.how7: Change your signature preferences to use your new signature on your emails.
messages.how8: Scroll to the bottom of the Settings page and select "Save."
